up: Retrieve molecules reported in document CHEMBL1121833. Join docs (filtered by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1121833'), compound_records, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Return the following columns: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id as chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name as name, molecule_dictionary.max_phase as max_phase, molecule_dictionary.molecule_type as type, and compound_structures.canonical_smiles as canonical_smiles. Sort the results by chembl_id in ascending order. Do not apply any LIMIT.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS name,
  md.max_phase AS max_phase,
  md.molecule_type AS type,
  cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1121833'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
